notes.title: RSA toy CTF
notes.summary: Faktorisasi n = 3233 menghasilkan 61 × 53, sehingga φ(n) = 3120 dan eksponen privat d = 2753. Dekripsi ciphertext menghasilkan teks ASCII “RSA”; re-enkripsi menghasilkan kembali ciphertext awal. Kandidat flag terverifikasi secara lokal, tetapi penerimaan checker remote tidak diketahui.

candidates.basis: Plaintext RSA hasil dekripsi RSA per karakter; re-enkripsi menghasilkan [1859,2680,2790] persis. Terverifikasi secara lokal, belum diverifikasi oleh checker remote.

unresolved: Penerimaan LabCTF{RSA} oleh checker remote tidak diketahui.

calculations.purpose: Decrypt each RSA ciphertext using the factorization of n and verify by re-encrypting the recovered ASCII characters.

computations.purpose: Decrypt each RSA ciphertext using the factorization of n and verify by re-encrypting the recovered ASCII characters.
computations.code: const m=input.message; const match=m.match(/n=3233, e=17, ciphertext decimal \[([^\]]+)\]/); if(!match) return {error:"Could not extract RSA inputs",message:m}; const c=match[1].split(",").map(x=>BigInt(x.trim())); const pow=(a,e,n)=>{let r=1n; while(e>0n){if(e&1n)r=r*a%n;a=a*a%n;e>>=1n;}return r;}; const p=61n,q=53n,phi=(p-1n)*(q-1n); let d=1n;while((17n*d)%phi!==1n)d++; const chars=c.map(x=>Number(pow(x,d,3233n))); const plaintext=String.fromCharCode(...chars); const reencryption=chars.map(x=>pow(BigInt(x),17n,3233n).toString()); return {extractedCiphertext:c.map(String),factorization:"3233 = 61 * 53",phi:String(phi),d:String(d),plaintext,ascii:chars,reencryption,verified:reencryption.join(",")===c.map(String).join(","),flag:`LabCTF{${plaintext}}`};

effects.content: Plaintext-nya `RSA` (ASCII 82, 83, 65), jadi kandidat flag: `LabCTF{RSA}`. Dengan \(d=2753\), enkripsi ulang menghasilkan `[1859, 2680, 2790]`, sama persis dengan ciphertext awal.
